title: अष्टादशोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Pradyumna fights Shalva, who rides his golden flying chariot and showers him with arrows. Struck by a mighty shaft, Pradyumna falls senseless in his chariot.
summary.kn: ಚಿನ್ನದ ಹಾರುವ ರಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಣವೃಷ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಶಾಲ್ವನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪ್ರದ್ಯುಮ್ನನು ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪ್ರಬಲ ಬಾಣದ ಹೊಡೆತಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರದ್ಯುಮ್ನನು ರಥದಲ್ಲೇ ಮೂರ್ಛಿತನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: प्रद्युम्न अपने स्वर्णिम उड़ने वाले रथ से बाण बरसाते शाल्व से लड़ते हैं। एक प्रबल बाण लगने से प्रद्युम्न रथ में ही मूर्च्छित हो जाते हैं।
summary.te: బంగారు ఎగిరే రథంపై బాణవర్షం కురిపించే శాల్వునితో ప్రద్యుమ్నుడు పోరాడతాడు. బలమైన బాణం తగిలి ప్రద్యుమ్నుడు రథంలోనే మూర్ఛపోతాడు.
summary.ta: பொன் பறக்கும் தேரிலிருந்து அம்பு மழை பொழியும் ஶால்வனுடன் ப்ரத்யும்னன் போரிடுகிறான். வலிய அம்பு தாக்க, ப்ரத்யும்னன் தேரிலேயே மயங்கி விழுகிறான்.
summary.ml: സ്വർണ്ണത്തേരിൽ പറക്കുന്ന ശാല്വനുമായി പ്രദ്യുമ്നൻ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുന്നു; അമ്പുമഴ ചൊരിയുന്ന ശാല്വൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പ്രഹരിക്കുന്നു. ശക്തമായ ഒരു അമ്പേറ്റ് പ്രദ്യുമ്നൻ ബോധരഹിതനായി രഥത്തിൽ വീഴുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.18; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा रौक्मिणेयो यादवान्भरतर्षभ ।
दंशितैर्हरिभिर्युक्तं रथमास्थाय काञ्चनम् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this to the Yadavas, Rukmini's son, bull of the Bharatas, mounted his golden chariot, yoked with armored horses.

verses.text:
उच्छ्रित्य मकरं केतुं व्यात्ताननमलंकृतम् ।
उत्पतद्भिरिवाकाशं तैर्हयैरन्वयात्परान् ॥

meaning.en: Raising his banner with a gaping-mouthed makara, adorned, he pursued the foe with horses that seemed to leap into the sky.

verses.text:
विक्षिपन्नादयंश्चापि धनुःश्रेष्ठं महाबलः ।
तूणखड्गधरः शूरो बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्रवान् ॥

meaning.en: The mighty hero shook and made resound his best of bows, with a quiver, a sword and a lizard-hide glove on his fingers.

verses.text:
स विद्युच्चलितं चापं विहरन्वै तलात्तलम् ।
मोहयामास दैतेयान्सर्वान्सौभनिवासिनः ॥

meaning.en: Moving his bow like flickering lightning from palm to palm, he bewildered all the Daityas who dwelt in Saubha.

verses.text:
नास्य विक्षिपतश्चापं संदधानस्य चासकृत् ।
अन्तरं ददृशे कश्चिन्निघ्नतः शात्रवान्रणे ॥

meaning.en: As he drew and shot, again and again, no one saw any gap in him as he struck the foe in battle.

verses.text:
मुखस्य वर्णो न विकल्पतेऽस्य
चेलुश्च गात्राणि न चापि तस्य ।
सिंहोन्नतं चाप्यभिगर्जतोऽस्य
शुश्राव लोकोऽद्भुतरूपमग्र्यम् ॥

meaning.en: The color of his face did not change, nor did his limbs tremble, and the world heard his roar, lofty as a lion's, supremely wondrous.

verses.text:
जलेचरः काञ्चनयष्टिसंस्थो
व्यात्ताननः सर्वतिमिप्रमाथी ।
वित्रासयन्राजति वाहमुख्ये
शाल्वस्य सेनाप्रमुखे ध्वजाग्र्यः ॥

meaning.en: On a golden pole, the best of banners, with a water creature, its mouth open, that crushes all great fish, shone at the head of the horses, in front of Shalva's army, terrifying it.

verses.text:
ततः स तूर्णं निष्पत्य प्रद्युम्नः शत्रुकर्शनः ।
शाल्वमेवाभिदुद्राव विधास्यन्कलहं नृप ॥

meaning.en: Then, rushing out quickly, Pradyumna, tormentor of foes, ran straight at Shalva, king, intending to fight.

verses.text:
अभियानं तु वीरेण प्रद्युम्नेन महाहवे ।
नामर्षयत संक्रुद्धः शाल्वः कुरुकुलोद्वह ॥

meaning.en: Enraged, Shalva, upholder of the Kuru line, could not bear the hero Pradyumna's attack in that great battle.

verses.text:
स रोषमदमत्तो वै कामगादवरुह्य च ।
प्रद्युम्नं योधयामास शाल्वः परपुरंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Drunk with rage and arrogance, Shalva, conqueror of enemy cities, got down from the moving city and fought Pradyumna.

verses.text:
तयोः सुतुमुलं युद्धं शाल्ववृष्णिप्रवीरयोः ।
समेता ददृशुर्लोका बलिवासवयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A most tumultuous battle took place between Shalva and the Vrishni hero, which the gathered people watched, like that of Bali and Vasava.

verses.text:
तस्य मायामयो वीर रथो हेमपरिष्कृतः ।
सध्वजः सपताकश्च सानुकर्षः सतूणवान् ॥

meaning.en: Hero, he had a chariot made of illusion, adorned with gold, with banner and pennant, with an attached side-car and quivers.

verses.text:
स तं रथवरं श्रीमान्समारुह्य किल प्रभो ।
मुमोच बाणान्कौरव्य प्रद्युम्नाय महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Mounting that excellent chariot, glorious and mighty, lord, he loosed arrows at Pradyumna, descendant of Kuru.

verses.text:
ततो बाणमयं वर्षं व्यसृजत्तरसा रणे ।
प्रद्युम्नो भुजवेगेन शाल्वं संमोहयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: Then Pradyumna swiftly loosed a rain of arrows in the battle, with the speed of his arm, as if bewildering Shalva.

verses.text:
स तैरभिहतः संख्ये नामर्षयत सौभराट् ।
शरान्दीप्ताग्निसंकाशान्मुमोच तनये मम ॥

meaning.en: Struck by them in the fight, the king of Saubha could not bear it and loosed arrows like blazing fire at my son.

verses.text:
स शाल्वबाणै राजेन्द्र विद्धो रुक्मिणिनन्दनः ।
मुमोच बाणं त्वरितो मर्मभेदिनमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Pierced by Shalva's arrows, king, Rukmini's son quickly shot an arrow that pierces vital parts in the battle.

verses.text:
तस्य वर्म विभिद्याशु स बाणो मत्सुतेरितः ।
बिभेद हृदयं पत्री स पपात मुमोह च ॥

meaning.en: Sent by my son, that arrow split his armor, and the feathered shaft pierced his heart; Shalva fell and swooned.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे शाल्वराजे विचेतसि ।
संप्राद्रवन्दानवेन्द्रा दारयन्तो वसुंधराम् ॥

meaning.en: When the king of Shalva fell unconscious, the Danava chiefs fled, tearing at the earth.

verses.text:
हाहाकृतमभूत्सैन्यं शाल्वस्य पृथिवीपते ।
नष्टसंज्ञे निपतिते तदा सौभपतौ नृप ॥

meaning.en: When the lord of Saubha lay fallen and senseless, king, Shalva's army cried out in alarm.

verses.text:
तत उत्थाय कौरव्य प्रतिलभ्य च चेतनाम् ।
मुमोच बाणं तरसा प्रद्युम्नाय महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Then, rising and regaining consciousness, descendant of Kuru, the mighty one swiftly shot an arrow at Pradyumna.

verses.text:
तेन विद्धो महाबाहुः प्रद्युम्नः समरे स्थितः ।
जत्रुदेशे भृशं वीरो व्यवासीदद्रथे तदा ॥

meaning.en: Pierced by it, mighty-armed Pradyumna, standing in battle, sank down in his chariot, struck deeply in the collarbone.

verses.text:
तं स विद्ध्वा महाराज शाल्वो रुक्मिणिनन्दनम् ।
ननाद सिंहनादं वै नादेनापूरयन्महीम् ॥

meaning.en: Having pierced Rukmini's son, great king, Shalva roared a lion's roar, filling the earth with the sound.

verses.text:
ततो मोहं समापन्ने तनये मम भारत ।
मुमोच बाणांस्त्वरितः पुनरन्यान्दुरासदान् ॥

meaning.en: Then, as my son fell into a swoon, descendant of Bharata, he quickly loosed other, unassailable arrows.

verses.text:
स तैरभिहतो बाणैर्बहुभिस्तेन मोहितः ।
निश्चेष्टः कौरवश्रेष्ठ प्रद्युम्नोऽभूद्रणाजिरे ॥

meaning.en: Struck by those many arrows and stunned, Pradyumna, best of the Kurus, lay motionless on the battlefield.
